title: East Nash Private Guest House, Walk to Starbucks
description:
Prime East Nashville location just 3 miles from Broadway and Nissan Stadium. Enjoy a private, comfortable guesthouse in a historic, walkable neighborhood near Cafe Roze, Jeni’s, Vinyl Tap, Rosepepper, coffee shops, restaurants, and bars. Designed for relaxing or working, with modern furnishings, fast Wi-Fi, dedicated workspace, keyless entry, and off-street parking.

The space
This private guesthouse was designed for comfort, privacy, and convenience. The space includes a cozy living area, dedicated workspace, fast Wi-Fi, Roku TV, and thoughtful touches throughout to make short or extended stays easy.

The spacious bathroom features an oversized walk-in shower and is stocked with soft, plush towels, making it easy to get ready for a night out or unwind after exploring Nashville.

Guest access
Guests have a private entrance with keyless entry and a personal door code. Off-street parking is available for one vehicle in our private driveway. Additional street parking is typically available nearby.

The guesthouse is separate from the main home, giving you your own private space to come and go as you please.

Other things to note
Keyless entry, with your own personal door code.

Maximum Occupancy for any reservation is two (2) Adults.
